title: Sterish Audit Verdict
description: Frozen v1 shape of the audit verdict document produced by the Sterish pipeline (stages 1-3) and consumed by the on-chain submitter, the verification API and the dashboard. See docs/specs/verdict-json.md.

content_hash.description: Canonical content hash v1 of the audited skill bytes. Identical to the value registered on-chain as VersionRecord.content_hash.

capabilities.description: Distinct capabilities the skill declares or was observed to exercise. Order is not significant.

findings.description: Every individual finding raised by any stage. May be empty for a clean SAFE audit.

evidence_hash.description: sha256 of the full off-chain audit report. Anchored on-chain as VersionRecord.evidence_hash so a served report can be verified against the ledger.

SpecVersion.description: Version of THIS schema, not of the skill. Major version 1 is what this file describes.

SkillId.description: Reverse-domain skill identifier, byte-identical to the skill_id registered on-chain.

SemVer.description: Semantic version, byte-identical to the version registered on-chain.

Sha256Hex.description: sha256 digest as exactly 64 lowercase hex characters. Uppercase is rejected so that string equality is a valid comparison everywhere.

Verdict.description: Maps 1:1 to the AuditVerdict enum in contracts/registry. UNAUDITED exists only as the contract's initial state and must never be submitted.

Risk.description: Human-facing risk band. Off-chain only: the Registry stores no risk field.

Score.description: Trust score. Submitted verbatim as submit_verdict(score); the contract rejects anything above 100 with InvalidTrustScore.

Capability.description: Exactly the Capability StrEnum in pipeline/src/sterish_pipeline/models.py.

Severity.description: Exactly the Severity StrEnum in pipeline/src/sterish_pipeline/models.py.

Stage.description: Which pipeline stage raised the finding: 1 = description scanner, 2 = declared-vs-actual static analysis, 3 = synthesis.

Recommendation.description: Machine-actionable instruction for an installing agent.

capability.description: Optional: present when the finding is attributable to one declared capability. Behavioural findings that map to no single capability omit it.

description.description: One human-readable sentence about what was found.

evidence.description: Pointer into the audited artifact or the trace that supports this finding, e.g. 'tools[0].description'. Required: every finding must be traceable to something a reader can check.

SubmittableVerdict.description: Profile applied by the on-chain submitter only. A document valid against the base schema but carrying verdict UNAUDITED is a legal artifact (it describes an unaudited version) but MUST NOT be handed to submit_verdict, which rejects it with InvalidVerdict (error 9).
